request.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_capability_intelligence.py -k 'projection_enforces_tight_budget_for_session_service_history or owner_pass_decision_summary_preserves_partial_source_coverage or explicit_empty_service_scope_remains_accountable_and_bounded or owner_pass'

verified_behaviors: ECI retains bounded per-owner scheduled and skipped decision counts when those decisions are present in the selected owner-pass trace.
Compacted ECI preserves the source observation count, omitted-row count, coverage status, and one detailed result reference.
Unknown decision classifications and source omissions remain partial rather than being presented as complete.
The empty agent-declared readiness scope remains separate from Environment owner-pass activity, and opportunity, fulfillment, and intervention burden remain unmeasured.

measurement_limits: The focused suite covers the changed service-accountability and ECI paths; the full repository suite was not run for this slice.
The tests and live projection readback do not measure agent receipt, intervention reduction, recurrence, or causal improvement in development outcomes.
